about: Engine-neutral Kenshi+ linked combat rules, stances, 7-limb zones, unarmed/armed/ranged exchanges, and fighter archetypes. [G data]

choreography.note: Opening probe met with a tight guard
Sidestepped kick into a crisp counterstrike
High roundhouse evaded with a spin
Rising strike checked at the midsection
Slip back from the uppercut and answer
Combination lands cleanly on the arm
Low sweep scores a knockdown -> kip-up recovery

extraplanar_choreography.note: Astral Lightning Blast arcs across the arena into the chest
Monk rushes in with a high roundhouse — Archon phases aside
Second Astral Lightning Blast grounded on raised forearm guard
Low sweep passes beneath levitating Archon — Hover Immunity!
Singularity Energy Burst implodes & detonates — knockdown into kip-up!
Monk lands Timed Perfect Parry on Starlight Rift-Lance -> instant Riposte!
Void-Talon Rend rakes across the guard at close quarters
Monk grounds the Astral Lightning Bolt with a two-hand deflection!

fourarm_choreography.note: Loader Brawler fires 4-beat counter-phased rib piston punches & uppercut!
Cyber-Lich rears twin dorsal claws overhead — Brawler cross-parries mid-level!
Upper arms lock high Aegis guard while twin lower hydraulic fists spear under!
Articulated Djed servo-arms unfold ±72° and snap across in a scissor-shear!
Lower arms sweep & clamp ribs while Lich intercepts with Dorsal Canopy guard!
Left dorsal claw forms canopy shield while Right dorsal claw spears over-shoulder!
4-Quadrant X-Crusher flares wide then slams inward — knockdown into kip-up!
Both dorsal servo-palms aim over the shoulders firing Triple Converging Plasma Lances!

arthropod_choreography.note: Twin raptorial scythe-arms flare high and snap shut across the guard!
Fore-claws deflect the steel slash -> instant species counter-lunge!
Secondary species volley (Venom Spit / Ram / Reap / Blitz) braced on raised shield!
Rapid lateral skitter-dodge evades charged cleave -> counterstrike!
Defender lands Timed Perfect Parry on apex lunge -> 0-Poise Riposte!
Counter-cut absorbed on hunched chitin carapace guard!
Aerial stinger jackhammer / skyward horn-gore lands cleanly!
Finishing tarantula rear & chitin slam drives home!
